build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball on a beam balancer using creator_lib
create_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable bottom position and scale
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene at a specified center x and bottom position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and beam
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to BALL solution tier using C.set_meta
